name: OpenVibe.Help
tagline: Answers, support and a way to reach people.
description: OpenVibe.Help will be the help and support center for every OpenVibe site: search answers drawn from the docs, wiki, blog and service status, follow troubleshooting guides, and open a ticket that stays one conversation on the web and by email. A Report Problem button on every site will attach the safe details staff need (release, request and trace ids) and never secrets.

pillars.title: Grounded answers
pillars.text: From the real docs, wiki and status, with sources.

pillars.title: One support inbox
pillars.text: Signed in or not, on the web or by email.

pillars.title: Report a problem
pillars.text: Useful, privacy-scrubbed details attached for you.

pillars.title: For your projects
pillars.text: A support widget and help center for sites built on OpenVibe.
